about: Every (runtime, case) of eval-vectors.json that fails until the runtime's U step of the undefined rollout (spec/js-undefined-value.md, §6) lands, keyed by the case note and naming that step. Shrink-only: a harness fails on an unexpected failure, on a listed case that now passes and on a listed note that names no case. Each U step empties its runtime; the file is deleted in U9.
